about: In a premium renovation the cost of a mistake is high: a natural stone slab cannot be redone, concealed doors need perfect wall geometry, and lighting in niches has to be planned at the rough-works stage. That is why we work only from working drawings and accept every concealed stage — electrics, plumbing, waterproofing — before it is closed up.

Engineering in a large apartment or house is a project of its own: ventilation with heat recovery, several air-conditioning zones, smart home, water treatment. We design these systems together with the interior so that service cupboards and access panels do not end up in the middle of the living room.
Renovation in boutique residences and central Kyiv
In boutique buildings the renovation is approved by the management company, works follow the building's schedule and materials are delivered under its rules. We take care of these approvals.
How much a luxury renovation costs

Turnkey renovation from $550 per m² covers works and rough materials. Finishing materials, furniture and appliances are estimated separately, because in the premium segment they define the total. For a 150 m² apartment the base calculation is 150 m² × $550; a design project costs from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500).

If CAS carries out the renovation to our design, the total stays within ±5% of the approved estimate. The exact figure comes from the estimate after a site survey; the survey is paid, its cost depends on the property.

faq: How much does a premium renovation cost?
From $550 per m² — works and rough materials. Finishing materials, furniture and appliances are estimated separately. A design project costs from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500).
How is luxury renovation different from a standard one?

In the complexity of details and precision: natural stone, concealed doors, shadow gaps, built-in lighting, complex engineering. Such a renovation is carried out only from working drawings with technical supervision.
Can you renovate to another designer's project?
Yes. We review the drawings, prepare an estimate and deliver; if needed, we coordinate decisions with the author of the design.
Who handles approvals with the building's management company?
We do. We approve the works, schedule and material deliveries under the building's rules.
How can I follow the renovation from abroad?
We send photo reports every 1–2 weeks, sign certificates for each stage and agree key decisions remotely.
